org.redown.authority: Behavior-derived preservation candidate, not a claim of flawless operation.
org.redown.confidenceMeaning: 0 is a conservative required-field value, not measured probability
org.redown.evidenceScope: offline source/local fixtures; installed Chrome and live provider unverified
knownLimits: No fresh site/browser acceptance; saved HTML and failing Remote-to-Remote are historical reported cases.

name: Gallery capture and remote transfer preservation boundary
statement: Capture supported site URLs in browser and route through existing gallery transfer paths. Preserve its existing external behavior while addressing defects; known limits remain explicit.
